# City Play Co.

> City Play Co. creates live, hosted city games for playful adults in St. Petersburg, Florida.

## Games

- St. Pete Detective Club: a live detective game and walking mystery through Downtown St. Pete. The first case, The Sea-Vamp Syndicate, has already been played. The next case date is not announced yet; follow https://www.instagram.com/cityplayco/ or join the email list at https://cityplayco.com/.
- The Banishment of Johnny Prime: a custom, in-person party game City Play Co. built for a private Halloween party in St. Petersburg, FL (October 31, 2026). Guests played on their own phones in the browser (no app): a scavenger hunt and mystery with 27 tasks across three zones, a live TV leaderboard, an original cartoon intro, theme song and credits, and a group summoning finale. Built from idea to game night in about three weeks. A highlight reel of real guests playing: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/U851Ah8EasM. Case study, videos and FAQ: https://cityplayco.com/johnny_halloween/

## Custom games for events

- City Play Co. designs bespoke in-person games for corporate events (team offsites, holiday parties, onboarding, conference socials) and for private parties (milestone birthdays, bachelor and bachelorette parties, themed parties).
- Each build includes a custom story and characters, tasks about the group and venue, original video and music, a phone game played in the browser, a live leaderboard, host controls, print-ready QR posters and a group finale.
- Handles up to 100 players; works best for groups of 20 to 60.
- Example and details: https://cityplayco.com/johnny_halloween/#bring
- Inquiries: ryan@communityplaytools.com or https://www.instagram.com/cityplayco/
